definitions.explanation: Describes an extremely wide range of differences; many different kinds or types with no two alike.

examples.japanese: ⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{価値観|かちかん}→価値観：10431_kachikan⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{千差万別|せんさばんべつ}だ。
⟦{意見|いけん}→意見：01303_iken⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{千差万別|せんさばんべつ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、⟦{一致|いっち}→一致：01733_icchi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}なかった→見る：00283_miru⟧。
examples.english: Opinions varied widely and no consensus was reached.

examples.japanese: ⟦{花|はな}→花：00523_hana⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{種類|しゅるい}→種類：01560_shurui⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{千差万別|せんさばんべつ}⟦である→である：09855_dearu⟧。
examples.english: There is a great variety of flower species.

notes:
FOUR-CHARACTER IDIOM (⟦{四字熟語|よじじゅくご}→四字熟語：15663_yojijukugo⟧):
{千差|せんさ} (a thousand differences) + {万別|ばんべつ} (ten thousand distinctions)

ETYMOLOGY:
- ⟦{千|せん}→千：00809_sen⟧: thousand
- ⟦{差|さ}→差：02771_sa⟧: difference
- ⟦{万|まん}→万：00795_man⟧/ばん: ten thousand
- ⟦{別|べつ}→別：01216_betsu⟧: distinction, separate
"A thousand differences and ten thousand distinctions" - emphasizing vast diversity.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {千差万別|せんさばんべつ}だ/⟦である→である：09855_dearu⟧ (is infinitely varied)
- {千差万別|せんさばんべつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧～ (various kinds of ~)
- {千差万別|せんさばんべつ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧ (being diverse...)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{多種多様|たしゅたよう}→多種多様：15329_tashutayou⟧: many kinds, diverse (more common, similar meaning)
- ⟦{十人十色|じゅうにんといろ}→十人十色：04770_juunintoiro⟧: ten people, ten colors (emphasizes individual differences)
- ⟦{様々|さまざま}→様々：01559_samazama⟧: various (simpler expression)
